html:
The temple of Athena on the Acropolis of Athens, built in fifteen years with money from the Delian League. Pericles pushed it through; Ictinus and Callicrates were the architects and Phidias led the sculpture. Its lines curve very slightly so that they look straight.

It later served as a church and a mosque. In 1687 a Venetian shell hit gunpowder the Ottomans had stored inside, and the explosion wrecked the middle of the building.
